set -eo pipefail
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp
echo '== QE + GPAW plane-wave PBE EOS on bulk Si; SSSP pseudo in-env, cell built in-code =='
cat > recipe.py <<'PYEOF'
import numpy as np, re, sys
from ase.build import bulk
from ase.eos import EquationOfState
from ase.calculators.espresso import Espresso, EspressoProfile
from gpaw import GPAW, PW

KPTS=(8,8,8); STRAINS=[0.98,0.99,1.00,1.01,1.02]; A0=5.47
REF_A0=5.468; REF_B0=88.8            # all-electron PBE Si (Delta-project / SSSP reference)
REPRO_BAND=0.015; XCODE_BAND=0.02    # two bands, two justifications (see README)

qe_profile=EspressoProfile(command='mpirun --allow-run-as-root -n 2 pw.x',
                           pseudo_dir='/opt/conda/share/sssp/efficiency')
qe_in={'system':{'ecutwfc':40,'ecutrho':320},'electrons':{'conv_thr':1e-8},'control':{'tprnfor':True}}
def qe_E(a):
    a.calc=Espresso(profile=qe_profile,pseudopotentials={'Si':'Si.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF'},
                    input_data=qe_in,kpts=KPTS); return a.get_potential_energy(),a
def gp_E(a):
    a.calc=GPAW(mode=PW(400),kpts=KPTS,xc='PBE',txt=None); return a.get_potential_energy(),a
def eos(ef):
    vols,es,last=[],[],None
    for s in STRAINS:
        si=bulk('Si','diamond',a=A0*s); e,at=ef(si); vols.append(si.get_volume()); es.append(e); last=at
    v0,e0,B=EquationOfState(vols,es).fit(); return (4*v0)**(1/3.), B*160.21766, last

aq,Bq,last_qe=eos(qe_E); ag,Bg,_=eos(gp_E)
pwo=open('espresso.pwo').read()
m=re.search(r'running on\s+(\d+)\s+processor',pwo); ranks=int(m.group(1)) if m else 0
fmax=float(np.abs(last_qe.get_forces()).max())

fail=[]
def chk(label,ok,detail):
    print(f"{label:26s} {detail}  [{'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'}]")
    if not ok: fail.append(label)
chk("qe_mpi_ranks", ranks==2, f"{ranks} want 2 (parallel pw.x)")
chk("qe_zero_force_symmetry", fmax<1e-3, f"maxF={fmax:.1e} eV/A want <1e-3 (diamond symmetry)")
chk("qe_a0_reproduces_ref", abs(aq-REF_A0)<REPRO_BAND, f"a0(QE)={aq:.4f} vs AE-PBE {REF_A0}={abs(aq-REF_A0):.4f}A want <{REPRO_BAND}")
chk("qe_B0_reproduces_ref", 80<Bq<95, f"B0(QE)={Bq:.1f}GPa (ref {REF_B0}) want 80..95")
chk("qe_gpaw_a0_agree", abs(aq-ag)<XCODE_BAND, f"|a0(QE)-a0(GPAW)|={abs(aq-ag):.4f}A want <{XCODE_BAND}")
chk("gpaw_a0_sane", abs(ag-REF_A0)<0.03, f"a0(GPAW)={ag:.4f} vs {REF_A0}")
with open('smoke-check.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(f"a0(QE)  ={aq:.4f} A  B0={Bq:.1f} GPa   [SSSP PBE ultrasoft]\n")
    f.write(f"a0(GPAW)={ag:.4f} A  B0={Bg:.1f} GPa   [PAW PBE]\n")
    f.write(f"reproduction: QE a0 vs all-electron PBE ref {REF_A0} A = {abs(aq-REF_A0):.4f} A (band {REPRO_BAND})\n")
    f.write(f"cross-code:   |a0(QE)-a0(GPAW)| = {abs(aq-ag):.4f} A (band {XCODE_BAND})\n")
    f.write(f"qe_mpi_ranks={ranks}  qe_max_force={fmax:.1e} eV/A\n")
print("----"); print(open('smoke-check.txt').read())
print("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED "+str(fail))
sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)

PYEOF
python3 recipe.py
